theater: 錫金東麓與不丹中央河谷

battle.name: 不丹戰爭
battle.theater: 錫金東麓與不丹中央河谷
battle.brief: 一八六四年八月，不丹自錫金越境，攻入英屬印度的杜爾斯與大吉嶺。英軍組成遠征縱隊，自比爾斯堡沿托爾薩河谷前進，冬春兩季攻入不丹中央河谷，攻破蓬卡與通薩兩座宗堡，逼訂辛楚拉條約。海上的支援全賴孟加拉海軍的淺水蒸汽砲艇，英國本土的鐵甲主力艦吃水太深，無力溯抵前線。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 一八六四年開打的是不丹王國與英國印度政府之間的戰爭，交戰主體是以武力恢復不丹秩序的不丹邊軍，與印度政府的遠征縱隊。不丹方面，名義上由德布拉賈（Deb Raja）主持國教與國事，實權卻集中於通薩本洛、帕羅本洛與蓬卡本洛等宗本（Penlop）手中，各宗再由宗本（dzongpen）分掌民政與兵事；兵制以宗為單位，按村社戶丁抽徵，步隊以本地打造的火繩槍、彎刀與圓盾為主，僅有數十門小型銅炮與後來購置的鑄鐵砲，糧秣依賴田賦與村社積穀，命令與消息靠驛馬、僧侶與山口哨所傳遞。英方方面，一八五八年東印度公司統治終止後，戰爭由英王室的印度政府全權主導，總督為再任的達豪西勛爵（一八六二年到任，一八六五年二月於任內病逝），全軍最高指揮為印度總司令威廉·戈姆中將，作戰由印度陸軍承擔，兵源為英籍營與印度土兵步兵團，後方設有軍需總監署、醫院、碼頭與郵遞線。海上的支援由孟加拉海軍，以及一八六一年後改隸皇家海軍東印度支隊的艦隊提供：以吃水淺的蒸汽砲艇與汽船在布拉瑪普特拉河上輸送糧秣、軍械與砲兵，並抽調海軍水兵組成海軍旅，配海軍三十二磅砲隨步兵攻堡。第三方是不丹的周邊勢力：尼泊爾的章布加爾曾提出出兵相助而英方婉拒；不丹也曾向清廷求援，中原方面未出兵，只以拖延與調處敷衍。
countriesEn: The war that broke out in 1864 was fought between the kingdom of Bhutan and the British administration of India: on the one side the Bhutanese border army, which was trying to restore Bhutan's own order by force, and on the other the expedition column of the Indian government. On the Bhutanese side the state was formally headed by the Deb Raja, who held the spiritual and ceremonial authority, while real power lay with the Penlops of Trongsa, Paro and Punakha, each dzong being administered in turn by a dzongpen. Military service was organised dzong by dzong: men were levied from the village communities, formed into companies armed with locally made matchlocks, curved swords and round shields, and supported by only a few dozen small bronze guns and a few cast-iron pieces bought later; grain came from land revenue and village stores, and orders and news travelled by pony, by monk and by the watch posts on the passes. On the British side, after the end of Company rule in 1858, the war was directed entirely by the Crown's Government of India. The Governor-General was Lord Dalhousie, returned to office in 1862 and dead in it in February 1865; the highest military authority was Commander-in-Chief India, General Sir William Gomm; the fighting was done by the Army in India, British regiments and Indian sepoy infantry, with a commissariat, hospitals, depots and a postal line behind them. At sea the support came from the Bengal Marine and from the Royal Navy's East Indies Station, formed in 1861: shallow-draft steam gunboats and steamers carried grain, ordnance and artillery up the Brahmaputra, and detachments of sailors formed a naval brigade manning naval thirty-two-pounders for the assault on the dzongs. Third parties were Bhutan's neighbours: the Rana of Nepal offered troops and was politely declined; Bhutan appealed to the Qing court for help and got none, the Chinese authorities content to stall and to mediate.
people: 英方的主導人物是陸軍中將約翰·斯圖爾特爵士（Sir John Stewart）。一八六四年秋，他自加爾各答與阿拉哈巴德調集兵員與軍需，組成以阿盧巴扎爾為基地的遠征縱隊，自比爾斯堡出發，率軍沿托爾薩河谷推進，於十二月五日攻破蓬卡宗堡，翌年又分兵攻取通薩。他的取法是用印度軍隊的山地經驗，而不是在歐洲式的正面消耗上浪費兵力。真正推動開戰的是孟加拉方面：在大吉嶺的英國專員羅伯特·布魯斯（Robert Bruce）屢次要求英方出兵，未及時獲准，事後仍被英國政府免職，成為此役最常被引用的教訓；印度總司令威廉·戈姆中將與總督達豪西勛爵在更高層次批准了遠征，達豪西推動的宗主權政策，要求把不丹與錫金置於英國的保護之下。不丹方面，實際掌權的通薩本洛烏金旺楚克是談判與議和的主導人物，他起初在兵敗之後仍以國內有事推延回覆，後來在英軍攻入河谷的壓力下同意談判；前線的入侵行動則多歸於邊區總管桑騰·措莫·多吉（Samten Tshomo Dorji）一系，蓬卡與通薩兩宗的守軍各以宗堡為依托組織抵抗，海軍旅則由皇家海軍東印度支隊派出的軍官率領，隊伍規模不大，卻把艦砲的射程與射界帶到了內陸堡壘之下。另外值得記住的是尼泊爾章布加爾與清廷兩方的反應：前者在英方婉拒其出兵之後仍向不丹遞交口信，後者對不丹的求援既不迅速回應也不出兵，兩者共同構成這場戰爭的外交背景。
peopleEn: The leading British figure was Lieutenant-General Sir John Stewart. In the autumn of 1864 he drew troops and stores from Calcutta and Allahabad, formed the expedition column based at Alubazar, marched it up the Torsa valley and stormed the dzong of Punakha on 5 December, and in the following year detached a force to take Trongsa. His instinct was to use the mountain experience of Indian troops rather than to squander lives in a European-style frontal assault. The man who really drove the war was Robert Bruce, the British Commissioner at Darjeeling, who pressed for British intervention, was not supported in time and was dismissed by the British government; he is the standing lesson of the campaign. At the higher level, approval for the expedition came from General Sir William Gomm and from the Governor-General, Lord Dalhousie, whose policy of paramountcy required Bhutan and Sikkim to be brought under British protection. On the Bhutanese side the negotiations and the eventual peace were in the hands of the Trongsa Penlop, Ugyen Wangchuck, who at first stalled behind the formula that matters at home were pressing, and only came to the table once the British column was deep in the river valley. The invasion across the frontier is generally credited to the line of the border governor, Samten Tshomo Dorji, while the dzongs of Punakha and Trongsa were each defended by their own garrisons. The naval brigade deserves its own line: led by an officer of the East Indies Station, it was small, but it brought the reach and the weight of naval guns to the walls of inland fortresses. The reactions of the Rana of Nepal and of the Qing court also belong on the record: the former sent word to the British side and to Bhutan even after his offer of troops was declined, and the latter neither answered Bhutan's appeal quickly nor sent troops, and together they make up the diplomatic background of the campaign.
kits: 卡面的鐵甲艦屬於英國海軍在十九世紀六十年代初那一次裝甲換裝。一八六一年服役的戰士號（HMS Warrior）是皇家海軍第一艘鐵殼裝甲巡洋艦；一八六二年下令建造的黑王子級，以及同期的王子權杖級，都是木殼外面包一條鐵帶的縱列火砲主力艦；而一八六三年開工、一八六九年才服役的災難級，第一次把火砲放進可迴轉的砲塔與裝甲堡內。同一年八月，美國內戰的莫比爾灣海戰裡，南方邦聯的鐵甲艦田納西號在聯邦監視艦的包圍下投降，第一次以實戰證明裝甲可以壓過木殼巡洋艦的縱列火力。可是這些裝甲主力艦對不丹戰爭毫無作用：布拉瑪普特拉河的水深不允許任何吃水稍深的主力艦溯流而上，遠征縱隊的海上支援只由孟加拉海軍的蒸汽砲艇、汽船與徵用來的運輸船承擔，船上載的是糧秣、煤炭、軍械與攻城砲，海軍旅的水兵則從船上卸下三十二磅海軍砲，供步兵攻城之用。就英軍自己的裝備而言，步兵主力是一八五三年式恩菲爾德步槍配一八五六年式刺刀；一八五六年式劍刺刀首次在實戰中大量使用，正是在對付不丹的彎刀與圓盾時證明價值，這是此役最常被後世兵書引用的裝備教訓。砲兵方面，除滑膛野戰砲外還投入了阿姆斯特朗後膛砲的實戰試驗。運輸方面，遠征依賴數千名印度勞工、騾馬與牛隻，以及自加爾各答經恆河與布拉瑪普特拉河再轉陸路的物資；不丹軍裝備以火繩槍與刀盾為主，攻城靠人梯、繩索與火藥。
kitsEn: The ironclad on the card belongs to the great armoured reconstruction of the British navy in the early 1860s. HMS Warrior, the first iron-hulled armoured frigate of the Royal Navy, was commissioned in 1861; the Black Prince class, ordered in 1862, and the contemporary Prince Consort class were wooden-hulled ships with an iron belt along the side, firing their guns in a broadside; and the Devastation class, laid down in 1863 and commissioned only in 1869, was the first to place the guns in a revolving turret inside an armoured barbette. In the same year the Battle of Mobile Bay, on 5 August 1864, saw the Confederate ironclad CSS Tennessee surrender under the fire of the Union monitors, the first proof in combat that armour outweighed the broadside of a wooden ship. None of this affected Bhutan. The Brahmaputra was too shallow for any capital ship of even moderate draught, and the naval support of the expedition was carried by the Bengal Marine's steam gunboats, steamers and hired transport vessels, whose cargo was grain, coal, ordnance and siege guns, while the sailors of the naval brigade landed thirty-two-pounders from the boats to batter the dzong walls. On the British side the infantry fought with the 1853 pattern Enfield rifle and the 1856 pattern bayonet, and it was the 1856 pattern sword bayonet, used in quantity for the first time in this campaign against the Bhutanese sword and shield, that gave the most quoted equipment lesson of the war. On the artillery side, alongside the smoothbore field pieces, Armstrong breech-loading guns were put into combat trial. In the rear, the expedition depended on several thousand Indian labourers, on mules and bullocks, and on freight that came by the Ganges and the Brahmaputra before being carried overland; the Bhutanese fought with matchlock, sword and shield, and took the walls with ladders, ropes and powder.
tactics: 不丹的戰術核心是以宗堡為支點的縱深阻擊。遠征縱隊沿托爾薩河谷前進時，每深入一段就要面對一道由石牆、木寨、削尖的樁木和深溝構成的防線；不丹守軍多佔據兩側高地與制高點，用火繩槍在五百步內齊射，待英軍被擠進狹窄谷底才以刀盾近身反衝，打完即退回堡寨。宗堡本身是方形多層建築，牆厚、門狹、外圍有壕溝，攻方必須先用砲火打開牆面，再由工兵架長梯與火藥。英軍這邊的戰術有兩層：一是後膛砲的試驗性使用，以阿姆斯特朗砲在兩千碼上打擊堡牆，先以海軍旅的艦砲與野戰砲建立壓制，再以步兵在寬鬆散兵線上以射擊推進；二是以劍刺刀解決最後一段白刃。攻蓬卡的戰鬥中，英軍以工兵在夜色中架起長梯，步兵在刺刀與劍刺刀支援下登牆，堡內守軍與進攻者在城頭短兵相接，此役之後劍刺刀被英軍當局正式認定為對付刀盾的有效兵器。另一個要點是封鎖與後勤：不丹不與英軍主力正面決戰，而是反覆切斷從阿盧巴扎爾基地到前線的運輸線，在托爾薩河與山道設卡、襲擊押運隊，英軍因此被迫留下大量武裝護隊，並把每次推進改成以連續跳躍的據點為目標。到一八六五年攻通薩時，孤守的守軍在破圍無望後自行炸毀堡體與儲藥，與堡同歸，英軍只奪得焦黑的城基。
tacticsEn: The core of Bhutanese method was a defence in depth anchored on the dzongs. As the column pushed up the Torsa valley it met, stage by stage, lines of stone wall, wooden stockade, sharpened stakes and ditch; the defenders usually held the ridges on either side, fired their matchlocks in volleys at five hundred yards, and only came on with sword and shield when the British were squeezed into the narrow floor of the valley, then withdrew behind their own works. The dzong itself was a many-storeyed square building with thick walls, narrow gates and a ditch outside, and the attacker had to open the wall with gunfire before the sappers could set scaling ladders and charges. The British method had two layers. First, the trial use of breech-loading guns: the single-shot accuracy of the Armstrong pieces was turned against the dzong walls at two thousand yards, with naval and field guns establishing a weight of fire before the infantry advanced in loose order, firing its way forward. Second, the resolution of the last stretch in hand-to-hand fighting with the bayonet, and specifically with the sword bayonet. In the assault on Punakha the sappers set long ladders in the dark and the troops climbed the wall with bayonets and sword bayonets, while inside the fort the defenders and the assault met at the parapet; after that action the sword bayonet was formally accepted as the right arm against knife and shield. A third point was blockade and logistics. Bhutan avoided meeting the British in the open and instead cut the line of supply from the base at Alubazar to the front again and again, blocking the Torsa road and the hill paths and striking the escort columns, so that the British had to keep large armed escorts and turn every advance into a series of jumping stages. When Trongsa was attacked in 1865, the isolated garrison, seeing no relief, blew up its own magazines and the dzong with them, and the British took only the burnt foundation.
data: 能核對的數字大致如下。不丹方面，可召集的兵力在六千至八千人之間，各方估計有出入；火炮數十門，多為小型銅炮與後購的鑄鐵炮，英軍在攻下各堡後檢查所獲的守軍武器總量，可以佐證其以火繩槍為主、刀盾為輔的編成。英方方面，一八六四年秋投入的遠征縱隊兵員在八千至一萬二千人之間，其中英籍營、工程兵與砲兵佔少數，主力是印度土兵步兵團，野戰炮、攻城炮與海軍旅的艦砲合計約五十門上下，各史料數目略有出入。自阿盧巴扎爾基地到蓬卡，行軍距離約一百三十至一百五十英里，途中越過數道海拔逾一萬二千呎的山口，全軍總行軍里程遠超三百英里。傷亡方面，英方死傷在數百至千餘之間，記錄分散於各營軍報；不丹軍的陣亡同樣難以核實，一般估在千人上下，另有一批被俘者。條約的主要數字是：不丹歸還一八六三年以來所奪的英方與商人財物，割讓杜爾斯一帶的部分土地，每年向英方支付五千盧比，並負擔英方派駐政治官的開支，同時承認錫金不受不丹管轄。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Bhutan could bring together something between six and eight thousand men, estimates varying from source to source; their artillery numbered a few dozen pieces, mostly small bronze guns with a few cast-iron ones bought later, and the quantity of weapons recovered from the dzongs after they fell supports a force armed mainly with matchlocks and supported by sword and shield. On the British side the expedition column numbered between eight thousand and twelve thousand men in the autumn of 1864, of whom only a minority were British troops, sappers and artillery, the rest being sepoy infantry; field, siege and naval guns together came to about fifty pieces, with some variation in the sources. From the base at Alubazar to Punakha the column marched something like one hundred and thirty to one hundred and fifty miles, crossing several passes above twelve thousand feet, and the total mileage of the army on the march ran well over three hundred miles. Casualties on the British side ran to several hundred dead and rather more than a thousand in all, the records scattered across regimental returns; the Bhutanese dead are equally hard to verify and are generally put at about a thousand, with a further number taken prisoner. The main numbers in the treaty were these: the return of the property of the British and of merchants seized since 1863, the cession of part of the ground in the Duars, an annual payment of five thousand rupees by Bhutan to the British, the cost of a British political officer to be borne by Bhutan, and the acknowledgement that Sikkim was not under Bhutanese control.
cause: 直接導火線是商路與主權的正面碰撞。一八六三年，英方以保護為名在不丹境內的帕里（Phari）一帶設立商站與駐兵，等於在別國腹地插旗；不丹視之為入侵，隨即封鎖由印度通往拉薩的商路，扣押英商貨物，並在通往不丹內陸的要道上設立關卡，不許英人通行。英方隨即提出兩項要求：歸還被扣物資，承認英商自由通商；不丹方面的回覆是國內有事、暫時不便，談判拖延達一年。期間又穿插兩件易燃的東西：一是東印度公司在不丹境內取得的茶園與工場租地權益被不丹藉故剝奪，涉及其在茶葉生意上的直接損失；二是錫金的地位，錫金的土邦王早已被架空，對外事務幾乎由英方接管，不丹卻仍以宗主自居並阻止英方修路通藏。英方要修的是從加爾各答經不丹直達拉薩的商路與後來的電報線，理由除了通商，還有防範俄國自北方伸入西藏的戰略考量。深層原因則是英國在次大陸推行的宗主權：自一八五七年平叛之後，公司時期靠兼併土邦建立起來的體系，被達豪西內閣升格為英國政府的政策，錫金、不丹、尼泊爾都必須被納入保護。這場戰爭於是既是邊界糾紛，也是英國把喜馬拉雅門戶打開的政治工程；不丹不能接受，因為一八六四年它仍以一個擁有完整主權的山地王國自居，認為自己在喜馬拉雅山南麓有權維持既有的關稅與邊界。
causeEn: The immediate spark was a collision of trade and sovereignty. In 1863 the British set up a trading post and a garrison at Phari inside Bhutan, in the name of protection, which was to the Bhutanese a flag planted in the belly of their own country; they replied by cutting the trade road from India to Lhasa, seizing British merchants' goods, and establishing checkpoints on the roads into the interior to stop British travellers. The British then made two demands: the return of the seized property, and free passage for British trade. The Bhutanese answer was that matters at home were pressing and the time was not convenient, and the negotiation dragged on for a year. Two more inflammable ingredients were mixed in. The first was tea: the East India Company's interests in tea gardens and works leased inside Bhutan were taken away on a pretext, touching its direct commercial losses. The second was Sikkim. The Maharaja of Sikkim had long since been reduced to a pension, and the external affairs of the state were practically in British hands, yet Bhutan still claimed to be its suzerain and would not let the British build a road through to Tibet. What the British wanted to build was a route from Calcutta to Lhasa through Bhutan, and later a telegraph line along it, and behind the commercial case lay the strategic fear of Russia advancing into Tibet from the north. The deeper cause was the paramountcy Britain was extending across the subcontinent: the system built by Company annexation of the Indian states after 1857 was raised by the Dalhousie administration into a policy of the British government, and Sikkim, Bhutan and Nepal were all to be brought under British protection. The war was therefore a border dispute and at the same time a piece of British political engineering to open the Himalayan door. Bhutan could not accept it, for in 1864 it still regarded itself as a mountain kingdom with complete sovereignty, and claimed the right to keep its own customs and its own frontier on the southern slopes of the Himalaya.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響，一半在邊界上，一半在英國的亞洲政策上。邊界方面，一八六五年之後英國在杜爾斯設永久駐軍，在噶倫堡（Kalimpong）設政治據點，把不丹與英屬印度之間的高地一段固定下來；不丹雖在形式上仍是獨立王國，但從此承認英方的勸告權，每年繳納象徵性的貢金，其對錫金的宗主權則被正式否定。錫金從此完全倒向英方；尼泊爾目睹不丹的下場，在一八六六年英尼條約中幾乎照抄不丹的條款，交出北部山口的長期租借權，尼泊爾此後得以避免捲入中英衝突，卻也因此被英國逐步收編為僱傭兵與外交棋子，廓爾喀部隊成為英國在喜馬拉雅與西藏方向的主要軍事資產。戰略層面的推動更為長遠：這場戰爭證明了在沒有鐵路、能通車的道路有限的高山地區，後膛砲、劍刺刀與工程兵合起來可以解決一座山頂堡壘，此後英國在喜馬拉雅與西藏的每一次遠征都沿用同一套辦法——工程兵開路，砲兵拆牆，步兵以刺刀登頂。通信與交通隨後跟上：一八七〇年代起英方沿不丹境內的路線敷設電報線，一八八〇年代鋪設通往西藏邊界的鐵路，一八九〇年英中條約把這條線變成國際邊界，一九一四年英藏協議劃出的麥克馬洪線，在地理上正是從一八六四年這場戰爭打開的通道延伸出來的。對不丹本身，此役是王權鞏固的關鍵，烏金旺楚克以能談判、能打仗取得朝廷與宗本們的信任，一九〇七年不丹宣布由他出任國王，王室自此不再依附於清廷的冊封與宗本的宗教權威。海軍方面同一時期的東印度支隊也在以裝甲艦重組，用以巡弋印度洋與壓制各地海軍；不丹戰爭雖無一艘鐵甲艦參戰，卻是在這個海軍擴張的背景下打的，它的後勤線正是靠東印度支隊與孟加拉海軍維持的。
impactEn: The consequences of this war divide into a half on the frontier and a half in British Asian policy. On the frontier: after 1865 the British established a permanent garrison in the Duars and a political post at Kalimpong, and fixed the high stretch of the border between Bhutan and British India. Bhutan remained a kingdom in form, but from that point accepted the British right of advice, paid a symbolic annual tribute, and formally renounced its suzerainty over Sikkim. Sikkim turned wholly to the British; Nepal, having watched what happened to Bhutan, took the Anglo-Nepalese treaty of 1866 and copied the Bhutanese terms almost line for line, conceding a long lease of the northern passes, and so avoided being drawn into the Sino-British conflict, while being gradually taken into the British system as a source of soldiers and diplomatic leverage, the Gurkha companies becoming the military asset of choice in the Himalaya and towards Tibet. The strategic consequences are longer lived. This war demonstrated that in high country without railways and with few roads passable to wheels, breech-loading guns, the sword bayonet and the sapper together could take a hilltop fortress; every later British expedition into the Himalaya and towards Tibet used the same recipe, sappers to open the way, guns to break the walls, infantry to go over the parapet with the bayonet. Communications and transport followed: telegraph lines were laid through Bhutan from the 1870s, the line to the Tibetan frontier was surveyed in the 1880s, the Anglo-Chinese convention of 1890 turned it into an international border, and the line the Anglo-Tibetan agreement of 1914 was to call the McMahon Line was, geographically, an extension of the corridor this war opened in 1864. For Bhutan itself the campaign was the hinge on which the monarchy turned: Ugyen Wangchuck earned the trust of the court and of the Penlops by showing that he could both fight and negotiate, and in 1907 he was proclaimed King of Bhutan, so that the royal house ceased to depend on Qing investiture and on the religious authority of the Buddhist Penlops. At sea the same period saw the East Indies Station reorganised around armoured ships for the policing of the Indian Ocean and the suppression of the local navies; no ironclad ever fought in Bhutan, but the campaign was fought in the shadow of that naval expansion, and its line of supply was kept open by the East Indies Station and the Bengal Marine.
result: 一八六四年八月起，不丹先發制人，攻入錫金的莫朗與拉伊卡特一帶，包圍大吉嶺附近的庫爾松與賈拉帕哈兩處英國據點，英軍被迫應戰。英方在十月下旬完成集結，遠征縱隊自阿盧巴扎爾基地出發，沿托爾薩河谷逐點推進，先取不丹在邊境的一系列要塞，再於十二月五日以砲火與工兵攻破蓬卡宗堡，攻堡戰中英軍首次大量使用劍刺刀。十二月十一日，斯圖爾特與不丹代表在辛楚拉簽訂條約：不丹歸還一八六三年以來所奪的英方與商人財物，割讓杜爾斯一帶的部分土地，承諾每年支付五千盧比並負擔英方政治官的駐地開支，答應不妨礙商旅通行、不干涉錫金，條約亦對英方在不丹內政上的勸告權作出措辭含糊而意思明顯的安排。戰事並未因條約而完全結束：英軍不肯就地停手，翌年繼續沿河谷推進，於一八六五年四月攻下通薩宗堡，守軍在堡內引爆儲藥與城體，與堡同毀，英軍僅得殘基。此後不丹遣使赴加爾各答，於一八六五年與英方補訂細則，落實割地、賠款與通商條款，並同意在加爾各答接受英方的勸告。軍事上的結果是：不丹的邊軍被逐出錫金與大吉嶺，宗堡的攻禦體系被證明抵禦不了後膛砲與工程兵；外交上的結果是：不丹保留王國的名分與內陸的主權，卻把邊境與對外關係交了出去，十九世紀以來不丹是喜馬拉雅山南麓屏障的格局，自此改寫。
resultEn: In August 1864 Bhutan struck first, pushing into the Morang and the Raikat, ringing the British posts of Kurseong and Jalapahar in the Darjeeling hills, and forcing the British to fight. By late October the British had closed their concentration, and the column marched out of the base at Alubazar, working its way up the Torsa valley, taking the Bhutanese outposts one by one, and on 5 December opened Punakha with gunfire and sappers, the assault being the first large-scale use of the sword bayonet. On 11 December Stewart and the Bhutanese representatives signed at Sinchula: Bhutan returned the property of the British and of merchants seized since 1863, ceded part of the ground in the Duars, undertook to pay five thousand rupees a year and to meet the cost of the British political officer, promised not to obstruct the passage of trade and not to interfere in Sikkim, and left the British right of advice in Bhutanese internal affairs in a wording that was vague in form and unmistakable in substance. The war did not stop there. The British would not accept a pause where they stood, and in the following year pushed further up the valley and took the dzong of Trongsa in April 1865, the garrison blowing up the magazines and the building with itself and leaving the British only the burnt base. Bhutan then sent an embassy to Calcutta, and in 1865 the terms were filled out in detail, the cession, the indemnity and the trade clauses, and Bhutan agreed to receive the advice of the British in Calcutta. The military result was that the Bhutanese border troops were driven out of Sikkim and the Darjeeling, and the dzong system of defence was proved unable to stand against breech-loading guns and sappers. The diplomatic result was that Bhutan kept the name of a kingdom and sovereignty over its interior, while giving away its frontier and its foreign relations, and the arrangement of the nineteenth century, in which Bhutan was a buffer of the southern Himalaya, was rewritten.
